recognize_zh: 視野中三顆嗜中性球的核都是單一圓形或橢圓形、染色質濃縮，細胞質淡且有細顆粒；成熟嗜中性球普遍不分葉，符合 Pelger-Huët 異常的低分葉表現。
features: Three neutrophils with round-to-oval non-segmented nuclei
Condensed, clumped chromatin despite lack of lobation
Moderate pale cytoplasm with fine granules; one cell with slightly vacuolated cytoplasm
Normochromic red cells with scattered polychromatic cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three neutrophils, each with a single round-to-oval nucleus with mature, condensed chromatin and no segmentation. Cytoplasm is pale with fine granules, and one cell shows slight cytoplasmic vacuolization. Red cells are normochromic with scattered polychromatic cells. Findings are consistent with hyposegmented neutrophils of Pelger-Huët type; the proportion of affected neutrophils and presence of dysplasia should be assessed to exclude pseudo-Pelger-Huët change.

ddx.vs: Myelocytes have round nuclei with finer, less condensed chromatin and usually more basophilic cytoplasm with primary granules.
Dysplastic cells are typically hypogranular, involve a subset of neutrophils, and occur with cytopenias or other dysplastic features.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm lacking neutrophilic granules.
